title: Feature flags
subtitle: Turn whole features off for everyone, with or without an update explaining it; admins keep access so they can turn it back on.

disableDialog.title: Disable {label}?
disableDialog.description: This posts an update everyone will see and takes {label} offline for non-admins immediately.
disableDialog.descriptionSilent: This takes {label} offline for non-admins immediately, without posting an update.
disableDialog.postUpdateHint: Everyone sees an update explaining what's happening.
disableDialog.postUpdateLaterHint: Nobody is told for now. You can still post the update later from this page.
disableDialog.silentBody: Nobody will be told why {label} stopped working. You can still post the update later from this page, and the message you picked is kept for it.

enableDialog.title: Re-enable {label}?
enableDialog.description: Optionally add a follow-up message posted to the same update. Leave blank to use the default "back online" message.
enableDialog.descriptionSilent: {label} comes back for everyone. No update was posted when it was turned off, so none is posted now either.

disabledScreen.title: {label} is disabled
disabledScreen.description: This feature has been disabled by an administrator. Please contact your administrator for further inquiries.

postDialog.title: Post an update about {label}
postDialog.description: Everyone will see why {label} is off. Re-enabling it later adds a follow-up to this update.
